purpose: First-round visual identity and UI direction exploration; not final assets or verified UI

directions.prompt:
Create a refined original visual-direction presentation board for "loppi" (always lowercase), a real macOS application: a quiet mint pixel rabbit continuously keeps the laptop's microphone and computer audio while the user works, then the user returns to dated events, transcripts, playback and their saved moments. This is a DESIGN EXPLORATION, not a fictional AI dashboard. The brand promise is effortless continuity and being able to return to a lived moment. No chatbot, no AI sparkle symbols, no made-up analytics, no compulsory pet care, no waveform as decoration, no recording-duration anxiety, no gradients/glows, no glassmorphism, no stock bento layout, no 3D mascot.

References: image 1 is the CURRENT upright listening rabbit, identity reference; keep its mint pixel-art character, cream muzzle, peach ear interiors, compact body and two upright ears. Image 2 is its CURRENT sleeping pose, identity reference. Image 3 is the current app screenshot ONLY for understanding existing functions; freely redesign hierarchy and surfaces. Preserve the rabbit as a small distinctive creature, not giant illustration wallpaper. Product chrome must be sophisticated, functional, highly readable, Chinese-first; editorial display type must never replace usable Chinese body text.

Output one large, landscape 3:2, high-resolution, impeccably art-directed identity-and-interface board. Flat frontal artwork, no laptop render or perspective mockup, no desk photos. A cohesive master board: small left identity column ~24% width (wordmark, a large enough rabbit specimen, five color chips, two type specimens, and a small black desktop entry hover panel with one rabbit and three actions "截图" "重点" "笔记"), and one large complete macOS app window ~72% width on the right, within generous controlled board margins. Tiny footer "EXPLORATION 01 · 2026". Maintain designer-quality typography, alignment, optical spacing and disciplined restraint.

The application window uses realistic simplified content for Saturday October 31, 2026. Navigation must retain "时间线" "处理队列" "人物库" "Agent 接入" "设置", but their arrangement may change to suit the direction. Current day title "10月31日" and "星期六". One small listening rabbit and explicit compact "正在记录" status with a discreet pause affordance. Show a COMPACT day overview with two labeled source tracks "麦克风" and "电脑声音", ticks 00 06 12 18 24, actual intervals and one now marker. The day list has three entries: "产品设计讨论" 14:00–15:20 with a two-line summary about simplifying the timeline and refining the rabbit; "午后随记" 12:40–12:52 with a one-line note; "一次关于开源的对话" 10:15–11:05 with a two-line summary and small "2 条现场记录". Align timestamps in a stable gutter. Include understated "+ 新建事件". List newest first. No invented search bar. No huge useless date icon. The full window fits in the image with readable key labels.

DIRECTION A — "日常手札 / FIELDNOTES". Design the whole board as a beautiful contemporary personal archive, with strong editorial conviction and quiet warmth. Main palette: clean warm paper #F8F6F0, ink #242724, warm rule #DBD7CE, tiny unmistakable vermilion #C44F35, the actual rabbit mint. NO sage-green canvas or green text. The black ink is primary; vermilion appears only as a tiny present-time tick, selected navigation indicator and a small editorial detail. Typography: a beautifully proportioned lowercase humanist wordmark "loppi", restrained serif date numerals and wordmark specimen contrasted with practical crisp Chinese sans body and compact monospaced timestamps. No faux handwritten script. Main window layout: very narrow quiet text navigation on the left, one continuous open-page reading field, clearly ruled event entries directly on paper rather than white cards. Space is deliberate but not vast; titles have clear typographic weight, metadata is modest and dark enough. Timeline has fine rules and precise solid interval bars, subtle discontinuities. A single distinctive double vertical tick, inspired by the rabbit's two ears, can be used sparingly as a time bookmark motif. No ear stickers on every component. UI radius mostly 4–6 px. The character is small, warm, and incidental to a serious personal object. Desired response: 'I would keep this open for years.' The board itself should feel like a designed independent publication, not a template.

DIRECTION B — "随身声录机 / POCKET INSTRUMENT". A distinctive modern utility with the tactility and rigorous typographic organization of a small professional audio instrument, made gentle by its one mint rabbit. Main palette cool mineral #ECEFEE, offwhite #FAFBF8, nearblack #202624, precise electric cobalt #2F54E8 in small areas, rabbit mint. Matte flat materials, no metallic gradients or faux physical controls. Typography compact grotesk humanist sans, very clear Chinese sans, tabular mono timestamps. Wordmark "loppi" slightly condensed, meticulously spaced, with a subtle squared dot on each i as a pixel echo. Board labels and grid are precise, not packed. Main app window uses compact top navigation with the five destinations (timeline selected via thin blue underline), a narrow date rail/column, and a clean centered event ledger. Full date title is restrained. Small compact dual-source day strip. Events use high-information horizontal rows with clear source labels and quiet separators, not giant rounded cards. Generous but efficient line spacing. The blue selection is strong and concise. Controls are sturdy short rectangles, 4 px corners; no pills everywhere. Build one original restrained visual motif from twin slim signal marks, subtly resonating with rabbit ears; no decorative sound wave. Small desktop panel is black with tiny blue focus accents. Desired response: 'a dependable, beloved little instrument', not hacker terminal or enterprise admin software.

DIRECTION C — "暮色伙伴 / STILL ROOM". A quiet contemporary desktop companion with nuanced, confident color and soft humane geometry. The UI stays LIGHT, not a dark theme. Main palette pale chalk lavender #F1EFF3, ivory #FBF9F3, aubergine ink #342F3A, muted lilac #B5A9C6, tiny soft apricot #DFA882, original mint rabbit as the primary living color. No green-tinted whole interface, no multicolor badges. Typography warm rounded humanist lowercase "loppi" wordmark, exceptionally clear Chinese sans, unhurried numerals. The rabbit has room to breathe in the compact day header; one small full-body mint creature beside concise recording state. Main app: quiet narrow left navigation with a tiny lilac vertical selection mark; main content arranged as a single calm day surface. The compact two-source day track sits in the open background, with two flat lilac recordings and a tiny apricot bookmark. Events are large soft rectangular reading panels with only 8–10 px corners, no stacked card nesting, no shadows. Panels are ivory on lavender chalk, generous inside spacing and excellent typographic contrast, three entries visible. Use subtle unique stepped-cut details echoing pixels only in the board's identity examples, not on all controls. Originality should come from precise warm/cool balance, silhouette, close typography and beautiful compositional pacing. A human, private everyday object rather than a wellness app, baby toy or corporate productivity platform. Desired response: 'it is here with me, and asks for nothing.'

review.A: Editorial hierarchy and ruled list are promising. Oversized date, heavy serif identity and large overview remain unresolved. Generated green source encoding and mixed status semantics are not design decisions.
review.B: More explicit tool character and denser navigation; generic productivity-app resemblance remains strong. Do not treat generated date rail or extra controls as approved information architecture.
review.C: Warm/cool balance supports companion feeling, but mostly recolors existing card shell and remains generic. Some metadata and labels have weak contrast.
review.shared: Typeface names, slogans, Chinese labels, time mappings, icon affordances and data semantics are unverified generated approximations. Current character is upright v2; generated variations and old folded-ear icon are not final identity assets.
